question: Patron of the Kitsune lets me gain 1 life whenever a creature attacks. If several creatures attack in the same declare attackers step, do I gain one life for each attacking creature?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you may gain one life per attacking creature when the ability resolves during each declare attackers step.
expected.answer: You may gain one life per attacking creature when the ability resolves during each declare attackers step.
